bullets: FOMC holds rates steady at 4.00% today; GDP, Core PCE and jobless claims due Thursday add event risk into the hold window.
AI optimism extends rally: SK Hynix profit beat and Anthropic IPO buzz lift Nasdaq futures +0.35%, VIX down 4.7% to 17.5.
Iran war costs balloon toward $47B and Israel election yields no clear majority, keeping Brent near $111 and geopolitics elevated.
Sector split: Software/Utilities/Materials up on the week while Semis -8% and Comms -7%, masking true risk appetite under the AI rally.

MSM.why: Stock fell on headline EPS miss (-16% y/y) from $42M noncash impairment tied to discontinued Digital Core tech program; adjusted EPS beat estimates, FY27 guidance raised. Analysts mostly bullish post-drop, but one listicle flags weak multi-year sales growth.
MSM.bull: Adjusted EPS beat, FY27 sales guidance raised 9.5-10.5%, and 3 of 4 analysts raised ratings/targets right after the plunge.
MSM.bear: Headline EPS fell 16% y/y on a $42M impairment, and one analyst flags weak multi-year sales/EPS growth versus industrial peers.
flags: noncash impairment drove headline EPS miss
